prose: Bill and his co-host from 13 Questions Podcast recently had me on to discuss some of life's biggest ponder-worthy questions.
Check it out, if you'd like to hear me do my best to answer the following:
topics: What was the best advice ever given to you? Would you modify it at all today?
What do you choose to ignore?
What book has been most influential on your life and why?
What rule do you have for yourself that you never break and why do you think that it's important?
If I were to ask your best friend what is the one thing they would say you need to work on the most? Why?
What turns you on creatively, spiritually or emotionally?
What was the most embarrassing or humbling experience of your life?
What is your greatest fear? How did you overcome it?
What is your single greatest driving force in life and how do you further it?
Who were/are your role models and why?
What quality do you most admire in a woman?
What is the most courageous thing you have ever done or seen in your life?
What does it mean to be a man in today's world?
